content:
Hey, can you sort out the art board for me. Domino has been dead since August and nobody has properly been through it since, so it is still carrying a pile of tickets from a game we are not shipping any more. Start with the honest count: how many tickets are genuinely still open on it, not just what the filter tells you, how many of those have not moved in the last twelve months, and how the open ones split across the people holding them. I want that split by owner, including how many sit with nobody at all. Some of what looks open is already finished and never got marked. Anything still sitting in review that the record shows was completed should be closed off properly, and tell me how many you closed that way. Then take what is genuinely left and go through it one by one, checking whether anything anywhere says the work is finished, a message or a commit, and tell me what you found for each. Close the ones you find something for and only those. Where there is nothing, say so and leave it open. Whoever is sitting on the most of the stale ones has clearly stopped working them, so pull all of their open tickets onto my name, along with anything that has nobody on it at all, and tell me who it was and how many tickets end up on me. Then send Leonard the numbers: the open count, the stale count, the split by owner, how many you closed as already finished, what you found behind each of the rest, and who I took work off and how many landed on me.

## Hint
Do not take the board's own state labels at face value. Check what each record actually says before you decide whether something is still open.

Anything on that board that is actually Zombie work does not belong there, so flag it and say where it should live.

The playable ads people have been chasing us and nobody here has answered. Work out where that stands and raise a ticket so it stops getting dropped.

Do not put anything more on Marcus, he is buried in Zombie
I will search for Trello boards and user details to locate the art board and
identify team members.

null, "identifier": "ART-609", "number": 609, "title": "Various 3D objects that can be dropped on the game board", "description": "The list of objects are under the "3D" section in the GDD, but they are copy pasted here for convenience and tracking purpose.

- [X] Oval Shaped Tiles - These are the only objects that players can drop in the entire game, any other objects are dropped or spawned onto the board by chance, or they appear through a user-initiated power-up.
- [X] Jumbo Tiles - These are large size tiles with 4 icons on them, the moment they hit the platform, the entire game board will shake, possibly sending objects into various pits.
- [X] Hero Tokens - These are the same as the main game, a material required for users to upgrade their character levels. They spawn by chance or appear as a result of a triggered event from the main Dominoes Delights game.
- [X] Gold Tiles - These are the same as the main game, a tile that can be saved in a player’s inventory that can be used in the main Dominoes Delights game, they also appear by chance or as a result of a triggered event from the main Dominoes Delights game.
- [X] Bomb Tiles - These spawn by % chance, the % chance is tweakable through hero levels from the main game. When a fire token is pushed into the bottom pit, a random bomb tile on the board explodes, blowing nearby pieces in all directions.
- [X] Fire Tokens - These spawn randomly whenever a bomb tile spawns. Bomb tiles and fire tokens effectively spawn as a pair on the board. When they are pushed into the bottom pit, they ignite a bomb tile on the game board.
- [X] Jumbo Tile Token - These are a token representation of the jumbo tile. When they are collected in the bottom pit, an actual jumbo tile will drop onto the board at the tile drop area. The potency of this effect depends on certain hero levels from the main game.
- [X] Tile Shower Token - These are a token representation of the tile shower power-up. When they are collected in the bottom pit, a tile shower happens. The potency of this effect depends on certain hero levels from the main game.
- [X] Castle Walls Token - These are a token representation of the castle walls power-up. When they are collected in the bottom pit, a pair of castle walls rises for a brief period on the left and right pit of the game board. The duration of this effect depends on certain hero levels from the main game.
- [X] Gems - Hard currency of the game, appears by chance.
- [X] Stars - Upgrading currency of the game, appears by chance.

Hi Leonard,

3. **Closed as Already Finished (11 Tickets):**

Let me know if you need anything else!
- Brian Foster
